red_find_instrumentdirs.pro


Routines

top source red_find_instrumentdirs

SST observations

result = red_find_instrumentdirs(topdir, instrument_prefix, data_prefix [, sublevels=integer] [, count=integer] [, /fold])

Look recursively for instrument-specific subdirectory below a given directory.

Subdirectories will be searched for by using regular expressions of the following type: "topdir+'/'+data_prefix+'*/'+levels+instrument_prefix+'*'", where levels consist of an increasing number of repetitions of "*/". Once matching subdirectories are found at a certain level, the search will not go deeper.

Return value

A string array with directory names.

Parameters

topdir in type=string

Look for directories below this one.

instrument_prefix in type=string

A string matching the instrument specific directories, like "crisp" or "chromis".

data_prefix in type=string

A string matching the data type directory, like "dark" or "flat".

Keywords

sublevels in optional type=integer default=3

The max number of levels of subdirectories to search.

count out optional type=integer

The number of found subdirectories.

fold out optional type=boolean default=true

Whether to fold cases when searching.
